message.content:
An editorial illustration for the magazine "TEMPO" features a central portrait of a man with black hair and tan skin. His head is positioned above a large, dark gray police uniform adorned with gold-colored buttons, insignias, and a name tag that reads "SUTARMAN". The uniform includes a white dress shirt and a black necktie. The man’s neck appears to be replaced by a large, upright white collar that curves around his head, creating a gap between the head and the shoulders of the uniform.

The background is a light blue-gray gradient. At the top, the red word "TEMPO" is prominently displayed. Above it, white text reads "GATOT-HOLLY: ANTARA MAUT DAN CINTA / PELESIR RAHASIA AKIL-ATUT". Below the red masthead, smaller white text states "EDISI 21-27 OKTOBER 2013". To the right of the central figure, large black block letters read "KAPOLRI SELERA CIKEAS". In the bottom right corner, there is a barcode, a price of "RP 33.000", the website "WWW.TEMPO.CO", and "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN ISSN: 0126 - 4273".
